title: Austin Electric Bike Tour: Let it Ride
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Tour leaves from 1707 Barton Springs Rd. Please arrive 15 early prior to start time
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Too hot for a regular bike tour? Wanna experience Austin in a new and exciting way? This ELECTRIC bike tour is for you! Check out Austin's favorite murals, landmarks, and history on this journey propelled by a pedal-assist E-bike. The " I love you so much" wall, Barton Springs pool, South Congress, downtown, and much more are all within reach! Halfway through the tour, we do stop for coffee/ beer/ snacks (not included) at a local Austin spot.
